jobs.title: AI GTM Program Manager
jobs.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier  agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the  entire  customer journey.

- We're taking  autonomous search  mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.

- We’re making  conversational shopping  a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.

- We're designing the future of  autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine —  Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Bloomreach builds agentic AI systems for our customers. We also run them ourselves.

Our AI SDR program books sales meetings with AI - inbound and outbound, across four regions, in multiple languages. The program needs an owner: someone who sets its direction, drives its results, and proves its ROI. This is a program leadership role, not an engineering one. Two dedicated AI ops experts build and run the platform. You decide what it does, why, and for whom. You should understand AI agents well enough to direct the people building them - your leverage is judgment, but being tech savvy is a must.

The team experiments by default: we test new AI tools, run scoped POCs, and keep what works. You'll own the program, its direction, its results, its pipeline number.

What you'll own

- The AI SDR program, end to end. Inbound and outbound, AMER + EMEA + APAC. Who gets enrolled, what the agents say, when a human takes over, and what it produces in pipeline. You set direction; the platform ops managers make it run. (Inbound request ops and routing sit with a colleague.)

- Pipeline as your number, ROI as your story. Meetings booked → accepted → qualified pipeline created. Cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar. You report the program's return to leadership, with numbers that hold up under questioning.

- The human SDR side. SDRs are the other half of the program - and where it most often breaks: lead quality disputes, unclear prioritization, follow-up that dies after one touch, handovers that lose context. You'll sit with the SDR teams and their leaders, find root causes, and fix them - with an AI assist, a process change, or a better definition.

- The human–agent split. What agents do, what humans do, and where the handover sits. You own that line and move it based on evidence.

- Signal-driven enrollment. Targeting runs on manual batches today. You'll drive the move to continuous enrollment based on account scoring, intent signals, and engagement decay. You define the logic; the ops team builds it.

- The buying experience. Outreach should arrive because an account signalled something, say something true about the buyer's business, and make the next step obvious.

- Program reporting. Volume, coverage, results, and ROI on a live dashboard, generated automatically. Parts still run on exports. Fix that early.

- What comes next. The AI SDR pattern - signal in, agent acts, human closes - applies beyond outbound: event follow-up, hand-raiser nurture, re-engagement. Once the core program runs well, you'll make the case for the next one and drive its launch.

What success looks like after 3 months

- Outbound volume and coverage are consistent across regions. Nobody asks "why did outbound drop last week?"

- Leadership references your ROI model in planning: cost per meeting, cost per pipeline dollar, trend.

- The top three SDR pain points from your first quarter are root-caused and fixed - and SDR leaders would confirm it unprompted.

- Meeting acceptance is high. Rejections have known causes, not theories.

- Reporting is fully automated. Your time goes into decisions.

- The program activities and volume is connected to human activities, pipeline number for ICP accounts is bigger - and you can show which changes drove it.

- At least one new agentic program is live and producing pipeline.

What you'll bring

- You've run programs with a number attached. Demand gen, SDR/BDR, growth, or GTM programs where you owned the outcome and defended the metric.

- You've operated AI workflows in production. You've deployed, directed, or owned automations other people depended on. You can set requirements, challenge the build, and tell when the agent is the problem versus the data. You don't need to write code - you do need to never be bluffed by it.

- ROI fluency. You can build a cost-per-outcome model and explain it. You'd rather show a live dashboard than a slide.

- You diagnose team problems at the source. "The leads are bad" is where your investigation starts, not where it ends. You've worked with frontline teams, found the real constraint, and fixed it.

- SDRs, AEs, and their leaders are your users. When the program misfires, you’ll be their point of contact.

- The buyer's point of view. Buyers don't care that outreach was efficient - only that it was worth their time. You'll kill a volume that doesn't clear that bar.

- Enough technical depth to be dangerous. You can read a workflow, question a data model, and learn a new tool in a week. Experience with our stack is welcome, not required.

- Global comfort. Four regions, several languages, overlap with US hours.

Big Advantage:: hands-on LLM tooling beyond vendor UIs (Claude Code, MCP, custom agents); time in or working with SDR/BDR  and demand gen function in B2B SaaS.

The stack you'll drive

Salesforce · Qualified · Salesloft · UserGems · Claude - plus a mandate to evaluate AI-native tooling with a clear bar for measurable impact.

The team

You'll join Marketing Operations six people who operationalize and automate everything in marketing. Two of them work full-time on the AI SDR platform: they build and run it; you set its direction and co-own it: reporting and attribution, co-own and maintain inbound/outbound processes and find new tools. It's a team that builds its own tools rather than filing tickets for them.
More things you'll like about Bloomreach:

Culture:

-
A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.

-
We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.

-
We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.

-
We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.

-
We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.

-
We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*.

-
The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5

Personal Development:

-
We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions.

-
Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.*

-
Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins.

-
Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)*

Well-being:

-
The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.*

-
Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.*

-
We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.

-
We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.

-
Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.*

Compensation:

-
Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.*

-
Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.*

-
We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!

-
We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!*

(*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)

Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!

Bloomreach is looking for a Business Consultant ! If you want to help top e-commerce businesses boost their performance, serve clients and get experience globally and have immediate, tangible results, join our Professional Services team as a Senior Business Consultant.

Building strong client relationships is crucial. You will continuously enhance their businesses, maximize platform utilization, and improve key performance indicators (KPIs) and return on investment (ROI). Collaborating with Customer Success Managers, you will develop business strategies and roadmaps aligned with each client’s goals and metrics.

You will develop a robust understanding of the Engagement Platform. Becoming an expert in the platform empowers you to guide clients and internal stakeholders effectively. Your responsibilities in client onboarding, platform adoption and feature utilization are crucial. Collaborating with internal teams to enhance product-focused services and drive process improvements is essential for success.

We are currently allowing flexibility for our employees to work from anywhere for the respective region (Czechia or Slovakia) or we are happy to meet you in our offices in Bratislava (Slovakia) or Brno, Prague (Czechia) on a full-time basis.

- Become a SME on the Bloomreach Engagement platform

- Provide leadership and guidance to the business consultancy practice in the DACH, Nordics, UK or Benelux regions.

- Support clients in bringing continuous improvement to their sites, shops or apps (audit web pages and online shops; design, manage and evaluate AB tests; propose changes to enhance customer experience and raise conversion rates)

- Communicate with clients, teach them how to use the CDP platform, suggest improvements to their products, prepare reports for their business decisions and project evaluation

- Oversee implementation of a client’s applications, websites or online shops

- Communicate regularly with clients through online channels and on-site visits

- Utilize AI tools to increase efficiency in your and customer's day to day work

Core skills and experience required for the role:

- Customer facing experience: You have some experience in B2B and/or B2C as a vendor, an agency, in-house eCommerce, or working in a SaaS or consultancy in a customer-facing role.

- Ownership, self-organisation and ability to navigate ambiguous situations: You can independently structure your work, manage multiple customer initiatives and make progress even when the path forward is not fully defined.

- Consulting mindset: you’re comfortable challenging assumptions, asking the right questions and acting as a trusted advisor rather than simply executing customer requests.

- Curiosity and a growth mindset. A genuine willingness to learn matters more to us than years on a CV.

- Stakeholder and relationship management: you can build credibility with customers and colleagues and manage different perspectives and create alignment around next steps

- English language business proficiency

Skills and experience that would be a strong advantage but are not required :

- AI enthusiasm is a strong advantage. This role is evolving fast with AI, and hands-on experience with LLMs, AI Agents or MCPs will set you apart.

- Working knowledge of a marketing technology or customer engagement platform: Bloomreach Engagement, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Klaviyo, Adobe, Braze, Emarsys, or similar.

- Fluency in German or a Nordic language would be a strong advantage alongside English.

- Industry or vertical expertise that enables you to bring relevant benchmarks, best practices and a strong point of view to customer conversations.

- Background in performance marketing, CRM manager or any experience with online analytics, marketing automation, personalization, campaigns, and similar

- Technical experience with APIs, SQL, HTML, JavaScript or similar technologies, allowing you to explore data, understand integrations or prototype solutions independently.

These are the skills every CSM in the team uses week to week. We'll teach you Bloomreach, but we need you to bring the foundations.

- Understand how customer data flows. Know how a customer's events, profiles and product catalogue data reaches Bloomreach (whether that be through web and mobile SDKs, APIs, imports, data warehouse connectors and our Data Hub) and understand how identity is stitched from anonymous visitor to known customer. Use that knowledge to sense-check a customer's setup and any spot gaps for technical experts to investigate before they limit results.

- Read usage against entitlements. Interpret health, adoption and consumption data (monthly unique visitors, profiles, events, email and SMS volumes) against what a customer has contracted, and be able to explain what this usage means for our customers - are they trending ahead/behind or over and if so, why.

- Triage problems properly. When something isn't working, work out whether it sits in the data, the configuration or the integration, gather the evidence, and route it to Support, consultancy or a partner with a clear, reproducible description or scope.

- Explain the numbers. Build and interpret reporting on campaign revenue, conversion, average order value and customer lifetime value. - Know what's possible, and brief it well. Understand what the platform can do across segmentation, scenarios, channels, personalisation, recommendations and search, so you can recommend realistic use cases and write a clear brief when a Technical or Business Consultant needs to build them.

- Use AI as a working tool. Use Loomi and other AI tools to analyse, research and draft, with the judgement to check and validate the output, and help customers put AI-driven capabilities to work in their own programmes.

- Deliver engagement at scale. Host and facilitate 1:many programmes such as masterclasses, new-customer mini summits, webinars and customer events, alongside workshops, technical deep dives and consulting sessions for individual customers.

- Partner with Account Management. Work closely with Account Managers and Renewal Specialists, bringing adoption, value, usage and relationship context into account and renewal conversations. - Customers' data and tracking are set up well enough to support the use cases they want to run, and gaps are spotted and resolved early.

- Technical issues are triaged quickly and land with the right team to resolve these issues first time.

- Customers understand how Bloomreach supports their goals and can see progress against them, backed by numbers they trust.

- Adoption across the platform is healthy and growing, including adoption of new as well well as AI and Agentic-driven capabilities.

- Customers engage with and value the programmes, events and resources available to them.

- Risk and growth signals reach the right people early, and customers are retained and satisfied.

Technical foundations

- 2+ years in a customer-facing role in B2B SaaS, e-commerce, marketing technology or digital marketing, ideally as a CSM or Technical Account Manager, or in solutions, implementation, martech operations or agency delivery, where you sat between marketers and technical teams.

- Hands-on experience with at least one marketing automation, ESP or CDP platform (Bloomreach, Klaviyo, Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Emarsys or similar), plus an understanding of the commerce data behind it (catalogue, cart, purchase) from platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce or Salesforce Commerce Cloud.

- Working knowledge of web tracking and data integration: how events and identifiers are captured, what APIs and data feeds do, and how consent affects what can be tracked.

- Comfortable with exploring data: Knowledge of SQL or strong spreadsheet skills to sanity-check a number, and familiarity with an analytics or BI tool such as GA4, Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Amplitude or Mixpanel.

- A working understanding of marketing attribution (last-touch versus multi-touch, lookback windows) and customer segmentation (RFM, cohort, lifecycle).

- A structured approach to problem-solving: when two systems disagree, you find out why rather than explain it away.

- Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills: you build trust and rapport quickly, keep relationships strong when much of the engagement is remote, digital or in group settings, and earn credibility with stakeholders from day-to-day practitioners to senior leaders.

- The ability to quickly understand a customer's business model, priorities and KPIs, and to map solutions to their goals and challenges.

- Confident presentation and facilitation skills, including explaining technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences, from a single-customer workshop to a room or virtual audience.

- Strong organisation and prioritisation, with the judgement to know where your time will have the most impact across a varied book of customers.

- Good judgement on when to bring in specialists, and the collaboration skills to work smoothly with Account Management, consultancy, partners, Support and Product.

Nice to have

- Knowledge of a templating language (Jinja, Liquid, AMPscript or Handlebars); basic HTML and CSS for email and web; a customer success platform such as Gainsight; or experience supporting a platform implementation or migration.
